item.title: Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
In Malaysia, I experienced job discrimination as a scrub nurse living with HIV from private hospitals and MOH. But NHS Scotland hired me, allowing me to work in OT. Under UK law and WHO guidelines, my HIV status is treated as a protected medical condition. The post Why Malaysia Lost Me To NHS Scotland — Scrub Nurse With HIV appeared first on CodeBlue .

item.title: Ranau Hospital Crisis: Doctors Working 48 To 72 Straight Hours — Medical Officer
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
